hooks.name: Attribution Capture Probe
hooks.description: Verifies that agent edits can actually be captured in this session. Without it, pre-commit cannot tell 'no AI edits' apart from 'capture broken' and would report agent work as human-only.

hooks.name: Track AI File Edits
hooks.description: Logs every agent file-write to .kiro-attribution.json for line-level AI code attribution tracking
